name: Impetus of Dionysus
description:
• You can hand-brew potions by [effect:insert][dark-gray]inserting[/dark-gray][/effect] water or ingredients into bottles.

  • Your potions cause their targets [effect:drunk][pink]drunken revelry[/pink][/effect], starting a happy hour if applied repeatedly, during which 50% of used potions are not consumed.

[dark-gray]"Revel with them in the last art of euphoria."[/dark-gray]

effects.explanation: Right-click on a bottle in your inventory with an item on your cursor. You can use a water bucket to fill bottles, then insert ingredients to brew. Right-click to brew 1 bottle, or shift-right-click to brew 3.

Grants +1❤️ attack damage for 10 seconds, nauseating briefly if applied to yourself or for the full duration if applied to enemies. Nauseated mobs randomly lose focus upon attacking and fire projectiles inaccurately.
